purpose_for_model: Read what is in the kitchen, optionally one location
example_assistant_reply: Paneer 200 gram, palak, dahi ek katori aur do tamatar.

purpose_for_model: Check whether specific items are available
example_assistant_reply: Haan, besan staples mein hai, thoda kam hai.

purpose_for_model: Add items the user bought or has
confirmation_rule: Repeat the parsed list and wait for yes
example_user_phrase: Do kilo aloo aur ek dozen ande laayi hoon
example_assistant_reply: Do kilo aloo aur barah ande jod doon?

purpose_for_model: Change quantity, location or staple level
example_assistant_reply: Atta 'kam' kar diya. List mein bhi daal doon?

purpose_for_model: Mark an item finished or thrown away
example_assistant_reply: Dahi khatam mark kar diya, theek?

purpose_for_model: Get ranked dish picks for a craving or meal slot
example_user_phrase: Kuch halka aur chatpata banana hai
example_assistant_reply: Aloo pyaaz ke pakode ya besan wali aloo sabzi. Kaunsi?

purpose_for_model: Adapt the chosen dish to missing items, spice, servings, equipment or diet
parameters: {recipe_id, missing?: string[], spice?: 1-5, servings?, equipment?, diet?}
example_assistant_reply: Koi baat nahi, tamatar ki jagah thoda dahi daal denge.

purpose_for_model: Start a Cook With Me session
example_assistant_reply: Chaliye. Pehle do pyaaz kaat lo. Ho jaye to bolna.

purpose_for_model: Go to the next step
example_assistant_reply: (plays cached audio of next step)

purpose_for_model: Go back one step
example_assistant_reply: (plays cached audio of previous step)

purpose_for_model: Repeat the current step, optionally slower
example_assistant_reply: (replays current step at slower pace)

purpose_for_model: Start a labelled timer
backend_call: PostgREST insert session_timers + data message to app for local alarm
example_user_phrase: Dal ke liye das minute ka timer laga do
example_assistant_reply: Das minute ka dal timer chalu.

purpose_for_model: Say how long is left on running timers
example_assistant_reply: Dal ke timer mein teen minute baaki.

purpose_for_model: Count a pressure-cooker whistle
example_assistant_reply: Pehli seeti. Do aur.

purpose_for_model: Get a state-aware fix for a cooking problem
confirmation_rule: none (safety advice is always spoken in full)
example_assistant_reply: Ghabraiye mat. Do chammach dahi milaiye aur agle step mein namak mat daaliye.

purpose_for_model: Record that the user did something differently
backend_call: PostgREST insert session_events; RPC save_memory if remember
confirmation_rule: Ask before turning it into a memory
example_assistant_reply: Theek hai, aage ke steps waise hi chalenge. Yaad rakhun?

purpose_for_model: Finish the session and preview pantry deduction
example_assistant_reply: Wah! Do aloo aur ek pyaaz kam kar diye. Theek hai?

purpose_for_model: Apply the deduction with any corrections
example_assistant_reply: Ho gaya, kitchen update kar diya.

purpose_for_model: Save rating and chips for the meal
example_assistant_reply: Agli baar mirch kam rakhenge.

purpose_for_model: Save a preference as a memory
confirmation_rule: Repeat the memory and wait for yes
example_user_phrase: Yaad rakhna, Papa ko kam tel chahiye
example_assistant_reply: Yaad rakh liya: Papa ke liye kam tel. Theek?

purpose_for_model: Say what has been learned
example_user_phrase: Tumhe mere baare mein kya yaad hai?
example_assistant_reply: Aapko lahsun zyada pasand hai aur teekha medium-high.

purpose_for_model: Forget a memory
example_assistant_reply: 'Lahsun zyada' bhool gaya. Theek?

purpose_for_model: Add items to the shopping list
example_assistant_reply: Tamatar list mein daal diye.

purpose_for_model: Read the shopping list
example_assistant_reply: Tamatar, atta aur dhaniya.

purpose_for_model: Switch to another household member's profile
backend_call: Agent loads member voice and taste profile
example_assistant_reply: Namaste Sunita ji.

purpose_for_model: Change language, pace, units or detail
example_assistant_reply: Ab dheere bolungi.

purpose_for_model: Save cooked food as a leftover
example_assistant_reply: Bachi sabzi kal tak ke liye rakh di.
